EV-000013

Heilbronn problem, 13 points in a convex region of unit area · Heilbronn problems · status unclear

Definition

Maximum over 13 points of min triangle area / area of their convex hull.

\max_P\frac{\min_{a,b,c}\operatorname{area}(abc)}{\operatorname{area}(\operatorname{conv}P)}

Domain: 13 points in the plane. Normalisation: area ratio. Direction: max.

Current value

0.0309 (bound)
